newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Man Yau in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Man Yau in acquisition talks.

text.p: Malaysia's Man Yau Holdings Bhd has said it was in negotiations "which may lead to the acquisition of significant assets".

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday, the company said details of the transactions would be announced once a definitive agreement was executed. It gave no other details or a time frame.
Man Yau makes and assembles plastic parts and components and is involved in property development. Its shares closed at 7.45 ringgit on October 21 before trading in the stock was suspended.
Man Yau has asked the exchange to continue the stock trading suspension until further notice.
